goal: Add 250 new authentic Omani dishes (pan_omani / gulf_shared) to the food database, emphasizing Omani staples: Shuwa, Majboos, Mashuai, Harees, Halwa, Mishkak, Sakhana, Kahwa.

pan_omani: Signature Omani dishes (Shuwa, Majboos family, Mashuai, Harees, Halwa, Mishkak, Sakhana, Ursiyah, Qeliah, Khubz Rakhal, Kahwa, Dhofar fruits)
gulf_shared: Gulf-wide dishes with an Omani preparation (biryani, samboosa, shawarma, shared sweets, breads and drinks)

meal_types.breakfast: Rakhal and khamir breads, foul, shakshuka, harees, date breakfasts
meal_types.lunch: Majboos and mashuai rice, shuwa, main dishes, grilled items, seafood
meal_types.snacks: Omani halwa, mishkak, kahwa, laban, salads and sweets
